lines.text: God tells Moses to receive an offering from every man whose heart compels him, so they can make a sanctuary.
The ark is made of cedar wood overlaid with pure gold, with gold rings and poles for carrying it.
God says He will meet with Moses above the mercy seat, between the two cherubim over the ark.
The table of acacia wood is overlaid with gold, and the Bread of the Presence goes on it.
The lampstand of hammered gold has six branches, and Moses is to set twelve lamps on it.
